name: Cleveland County, OK
findings: Cleveland County has 642 nonprofit organizations. 263 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 216 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cleveland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Cleveland County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 146 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Cleveland County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 3 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 36 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
